questions.question: You added a column with manage_posts_columns but every cell is empty. What's missing?

options.label: You also need to hook manage_posts_custom_column to render the cell content
Columns need to be re-saved under Screen Options
The column key must match an existing meta key exactly

feedback.correct: Exactly — manage_posts_columns only adds the header. manage_posts_custom_column is what actually echoes each row's value.
feedback.incorrect: The header shows up on its own, but it stays empty until you also hook manage_posts_custom_column to output the value for each row.
